verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms docs.pinecone.io/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an official Pinecone docs index, and that index also lists machine-readable OpenAPI specs. The official MCP server additionally lets agents search Pinecone documentation directly, so there are multiple agent-oriented paths into the docs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming llms.txt, evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt)

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.pinecone.io/llms.txt # Pinecone Docs
docs.pinecone.io publishes an "## OpenAPI Specs" index listing dated machine-readable specs for every API surface
Using the MCP server, agents can search Pinecone documentation, manage indexes, upsert data, and query indexes for relevant information.
